---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a new feature or improvement
labels: enhancement
---

## Summary

A short description of what you'd like to see.

## Motivation

Why is this useful? What problem does it solve, or what workflow does it improve?

## Proposed design (optional)

If you have a concrete idea for how this could work — new syntax, new CLI flag, API
shape — sketch it here. Rough notes are fine.

## Alternatives considered

Any other approaches you looked at and why you preferred this one.
